$comment: Name display of a reel (FX2, D411; replaces the RP4 centre card over a blurred copy, which the user did not pick on 2026-11-20: 'extremely basic, and it's at the center bluring all gameplay behind'). Three styles drawn as an ASS subtitle file by libass in the reel's own render: lower-third, corner-tag, kinetic. The game picture is never blurred or darkened; the text has an outline and a hard shadow only. The text is the streamer brand from data/profile.local.json (never committed). Read by services/clip/reel_title.py. The style, position, colour, size and length come from the clip look (data/clip/look.json, Settings > Clips). Entrances under 600 ms, exits under 400 ms (overlay rule).
approved: user 2026-11-20 chose the three styles and no blur; timings, sizes and colours are the agent's proposal (plan FX2)
why: Lower third: an accent bar slides in from the left in 250 ms and the name types on over it within 450 ms, then fades out in 300 ms. Corner tag: a small rounded badge pops in with a slight overshoot (220 ms), stays the whole clip and dims to 70 % after 2 s, fades out in 250 ms. Kinetic: big letters pop in one by one in the upper third (scale-punch or slice-in), the last letter is in by 560 ms, fades out in 300 ms. Text is cut at maxChars and shrunk to fit the safe width.
